name: Face Mist Lemon & Mint
description: This clarifying mist blends lemon's natural astringent properties with mint's cooling effect for a fresh, matte finish. Specially formulated with natural ingredients, vitamins, extracts, and essential oils for giving facial skin instant hit of hydration boost. This citrusy concoction lightens blemishes, leaving your skin soft, supple and hydrated.
ingredients: Pure Lemon Extract (Citrus Limon Fruit Extract)
benefits: Removes excess oil buildup from facial skin
Refreshes and brightens skin with energizing lemon
Helps with sunburns, brightens skin, reduces blemishes and acne-scars, removes dirt from pores
usage: Spray 2-3 times evenly across the face and neck can be used anytime during the day to refresh and moisturize the skin. Can be used for instant hydration, as a toner, before makeup as a primer, other application of makeup to set it.
